verdict.rationale: React itself provides server-side rendering with streaming HTML (react-docs-6) and async server components (react-docs-7), which are prerequisites for serverless/edge deployment, but React explicitly defers actual deployment and infrastructure to third-party frameworks like Next.js or React Router (react-docs-4) rather than shipping any deployment tooling itself. missing for 10: evidence of React itself (not a downstream framework) providing serverless/edge deployment configs, adapters, or zero-config hosting integration.
